prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE beautifully art-directed, very high-resolution desktop website design screenshot for 8x Social showing the NEXT section after the supplied Day-to-day reference. The reference is context for the exact warm stone colour #e9e5dc, Inter typography and gutters, not an image to repeat. This is a seamless editorial continuation of that same page. Follow the restraint and consistency of Listen Labs: generous spacing, precise typography, local interactions, not their brand colours or assets.

Compose a wide 1600 by 1200 flat website screenshot. All background is an uninterrupted solid warm stone #e9e5dc, typography nearly black #111, limited orange #f34b32 used for one active dot and one slender underline. No gradients, white cards, glass, shadows or hero scene. At the very top show only the last 140px of the PRECEDING Day-to-day content: bottom two thin accordion rows on left, tiny lower fragment of the creator video's dot-textured edge on right, and its @judyintech caption. These previous elements are clipped by the top of this screenshot deliberately, because this is a mid-scroll view, NOT a new standalone page. No repeated hero image or nav.

Then plenty of stone breathing room. A very thin horizontal rule extends between matching 80px side margins. Below starts the new PARTNER FEEDBACK section. Use a beautifully asymmetrical 35%/65% two-column editorial grid. Left column large bold but not hero-scale headline on two lines, exact words “In good\ncompany.”. Underneath, three understated industry tabs arranged VERTICALLY, NOT pill buttons: “Career tech”, “Wellness”, “AI & software”. Active Career tech has small orange dot and a short orange rule, other two subdued charcoal, all readable medium size with wide spacing. Right column: a single enormous open orange quotation mark above an oversized tightly kerned black quote, exact words “a dedicated growth team embedded in our pipeline”. Use clean mixed-case Inter medium, around 64px, 3 balanced lines, absolutely no card container. Attribution well below quote, exact “Marketing Lead” then “Career Tech brand” in secondary small text. This quotation is a real short excerpt from 8x website, anonymous; do not attribute to any named brand. Small plain previous/next arrow controls aligned right underneath, no circular decorative widgets.

Below this composition after open negative space, one more thin rule, then a single restrained baseline row of black brand wordmarks with exact names “JobCopilot” “aiApply” “adzuna” “WOWTEA” and “e-Matura”, evenly spaced. These are separate trusted-brand identities, NOT the quote author. The page looks intentional, iconic and expensive through composition, not decoration. Brand logos have their distinctive existing shapes where possible, no invented data. No big numbers or invented performance metrics, no photography in the new section, no repeated 8x mark. Strong type hierarchy, optical alignment, 80px gutters carried from the preceding section. Convey ONE continuous web page, not a moodboard, no labels outside the design, no drop shadows, no explanatory annotation, no browser chrome.
motion: Native page flow. Industry click changes only the quote, attribution and orange active indicator within fixed dimensions. 180–240ms fade, reduced motion instant. No automatic cycling or new full-screen scene.
